title: A letter at the shop door
paragraphs: Your parent ran this herb shop for many years. The shop sells jamu, salep and other herbal goods.
Your parent left on an expedition and did not come back. The shop is now yours.
The shop also has a large riba debt. The interest grows every month, and there are hidden fees.
Plan each week. Make good products. Keep a buffer. Pay the bills at the end of each month.
The debt is heavy, but the shop can bloom again.
source: docs:gdd/02-game-overview/02-story-and-setting (backstory, tone: do not shame the player for debt)
